headline: EU delays AI Act rules — Gatekeeper slips, Self-Destruction rises
body: Europe blinked. EU negotiators agreed a provisional deal to delay and simplify the AI Act: standalone high-risk rules move to December 2027 and embedded ones to August 2028, though a ban on nudification and child-abuse-image tools was added. Pushing back the world's main AI rulebook weakens Global Coordination. That hurts Gatekeeper, the ending where the world works together to cap AI, and 1984, while lifting Self-Destruction, where a lack of cooperation lets risks grow. Cloudflare also cut about 1,100 jobs, around 20%, saying AI made many roles obsolete, a hit to Shared Prosperity and Egalitarian Utopia. Horizon Balance eased to +1.97, down 0.08.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.6, Self-Destruction +0.4 and 1984 -0.3, all from the EU AI Act delay (-0.57, +0.40 and -0.32).
